provenance: Official publisher Markdown exports at https://www.meilisearch.com/docs/ on 2026-11-07, from the MIT documentation repository https://github.com/meilisearch/documentation/tree/0ad8e464d2a469a2fc6fd53566111a0da1dc1895. The repository’s bundled OpenAPI spec identifies version 1.56.1. Devline removed the duplicated export index preface and normalized fenced-code attributes and export links. The OpenAPI material remains in the publisher's YAML representation. Devline preserved the published OpenAPI YAML as a code block with in-document field anchors, and repaired selected internal links to their corresponding published fields and headings.
coverage: Self-hosting, configuration, security, troubleshooting, data backup, search and indexing capabilities, SDK quick starts, errors, and the published REST endpoint reference for the 1.56.1 OpenAPI snapshot.
omissions: Cloud operations, Cloud analytics, Enterprise sharding guides, most older release notes, hosted assets, interactive API consoles, and complete SDK API manuals are outside this snapshot.
